top_signals.title: Japan 20-Year Bond Sale Demand Is Weaker Than 12-Month Average
top_signals.summary: Japan’s 20-year government bond auction Wednesday saw lower demand than the 12-month average, as investors remained wary of further yield increases amid fiscal concerns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
